title: Rapper Alley Boy Dead at 42 Following Battle With Kidney Disease: 21 Savage, Master P & More Pay Tribute
summary: The late artist's daughter confirmed his death in a post to social media on July 20.
contentText:
Atlanta rapper Alley Boy (born Curt Freeman) is dead at 42 years old. Alley Boy’s daughter confirmed his death in a post to Instagram on Monday (July 20).

“07-20-2026 [heartbroken emoji],” she wrote alongside a throwback photo of herself with her father.

“Mannn omg I’ma miss you so much man,” she added in a series of gut-wrenching posts to her Instagram Stories. “I wouldn’t wish this feeling on NOBODY.”

Billboard has reached out to reps for Alley Boy.

Moving tributes have poured in from rap figures including 2 Chainz, CeeLo Green, Master P, 21 Savage, Boosie Badazz and more.

“R.I.P TO ONE OF THE MOST REALEST SOLDIERS IN THE GAME! Alley Boy Da Don We made some of the best street music ever. #OtherSide Rest in paradise soldier,” Master P wrote on his Instagram account. P collaborated with Alley Boy on a handful of occasions and signed him to No Limit Records as part of the Louie V Mob alongside Fat Trel.

21 Savage added in an Instagram Story: “The blueprint east Atlanta legend 4L!”

CeeLo Green recalled the early days of running into Alley Boy Da Don around Atlanta and witnessing him grind to success. “#Eastside you all should be proud #atlanta we lost another real one. Prayers and condolences to your family and friends and supporters,” he shared on IG . “#rip to TROUBLE and Dave as well. @bigbankatl much love to you OG for creating a space and giving these talented young brothers a shot at this shit! The city got love and respect for y’all. keep going brother! Love.”

Alley Boy has been open about his battle with kidney disease. In 2023, the rapper revealed he began dialysis. He told Off the Porch that drinking lean was the root of his kidney issues, and he was still awaiting a transplant in late 2024.

“From drinking lean. I be telling n—as, all along I was drinking the lean,” he explained. “I used to sell it, so I always had it. The whole time, I’m allergic to opioids and didn’t know it. I was drinking poison the whole time. Making my blood pressure go up.”

Alley Boy Da Don’s brother, Perspektives With Bank host Big Bank Black, cofounded Duct Tape Entertainment in 2005 while Alley Boy was in prison. They rose to prominence in Atlanta and earned a distribution deal with Atlantic Records.

Alley Boy released plenty of projects over the years, including War Cry , The Gift of Discernment and  Blatlanta 3 , as well as his work with No Limit as part of the Louie V Mob. He was a close affiliate of Trouble, who died in 2022, and also notched collaborations with Jeezy, Future, Pusha T, Gucci Mane and Meek Mill.

For his final interview, Alley Boy sat down with his brother Big Bank for an episode of Perspektives With Bank in June.
